careers.summary: Designs, writes and maintains the code behind apps, websites and the systems that run them.

careers.title: Data scientist
careers.summary: Uses statistics and code to find patterns in data and build models that predict or explain what happens.

careers.summary: Turns business data into clear reports and dashboards so teams know what is working.

work: Pull data with SQL and spreadsheets
Build dashboards and weekly reports
Answer questions like 'why did sales drop in March?'

routes.label: Any numbers-heavy degree

Excel, SQL and a dashboard tool such as Power BI or Tableau

Build a portfolio of 3 analyses on public data

careers.title: UX designer
careers.summary: Works out how an app or website should work and feel, so people can do what they came to do.

Sketch flows and build clickable prototypes
Work with engineers to ship the design

careers.title: Graphic designer
careers.summary: Creates the visuals people see every day: logos, posters, packaging, social media and books.

careers.summary: Brings characters, scenes and effects to life for films, games, ads and explainers.
careers.summary_hi: फ़िल्मों, गेम और विज्ञापनों के लिए किरदारों, दृश्यों और इफ़ेक्ट्स में जान डालते हैं।
work: Animate characters frame by frame or with rigs
Build 3D models and scenes
Composite effects into live footage

careers.summary: Designs clothes and accessories, from the first sketch to a finished collection.

careers.summary: Designs buildings and spaces that are safe, useful and good to be in, and sees them through construction.
